verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm that Stark Bank serves an llms.txt at docs.starkbank.com/llms.txt, which identifies itself as the developer documentation index for the API. They also confirm a markdown rendering of the API reference at /api.md, so an agent can be pointed directly at LLM-friendly docs. The docs separately offer a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 YAML as machine-readable context, although probes of the common openapi.json paths returned 404. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the agent-oriented docs (e.g. an llms-full.txt or guidance for agent use), evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it successfully.
